findings.title: Integer Overflow and Underflow
findings.description: Mathematical operation may result in integer overflow or underflow in Solidity versions prior to 0.8.0.
findings.recommendation: Use compiler version >= 0.8.0 which has built-in overflow checks, or use SafeMath.
